id-20261009-news-1.title: Ahead of the 2027 UMP Determination: How to Read the Minimum Wage Formula Amid Layoffs and Food Inflation

segments.src: Setiap menjelang akhir tahun, perbincangan tentang upah minimum kembali ramai.
segments.tr: Every near the end of the year, discussions about the minimum wage become lively again.

segments.src: Pembahasan upah minimum provinsi (UMP) biasanya dimulai sekitar Oktober, dan penetapannya dilakukan paling lambat pada November untuk berlaku mulai awal tahun berikutnya.
segments.tr: Discussions on the provincial minimum wage (UMP) usually start around October, and its determination is made no later than November to take effect from the beginning of the following year.

segments.src: Tahun ini, diskusi terasa lebih sensitif karena berbagai kabar pemutusan hubungan kerja (PHK) di sejumlah sektor serta harga pangan yang masih menjadi beban rumah tangga.
segments.tr: This year, the discussion feels more sensitive due to various news of layoffs in several sectors as well as food prices which remain a burden on households.

segments.src: Artikel ini tidak bermaksud memihak.
segments.tr: This article does not intend to take sides.

segments.src: Tujuannya membantu pembaca memahami **bagaimana formula upah minimum bekerja**, komponen apa saja yang masuk, dan mengapa pekerja serta pengusaha sering memandang angka yang sama dengan cara berbeda.
segments.tr: Its purpose is to help readers understand **how the minimum wage formula works**, what components are included, and why workers and employers often view the same figures in different ways.

segments.src: ## Apa itu upah minimum dan siapa yang menetapkan?
segments.tr: ## What is the minimum wage and who determines it?

segments.src: Upah minimum adalah batas bawah upah bulanan yang harus dibayarkan pemberi kerja kepada pekerja.
segments.tr: The minimum wage is the lower limit of the monthly wage that employers must pay to workers.

segments.src: Secara umum:
segments.tr: In general:

segments.src: - **UMP** ditetapkan gubernur untuk satu provinsi.
segments.tr: - **UMP** is determined by the governor for one province.

segments.src: - **UMK** (kabupaten/kota) dapat ditetapkan bila daerah memenuhi syarat dan mempertimbangkan rekomendasi bupati atau wali kota.
segments.tr: - **UMK** (regency/city) can be determined if the region meets the requirements and considers the recommendation of the regent or mayor.

segments.src: - Upah minimum sektoral dapat berlaku pada sektor tertentu, sesuai kesepakatan dan aturan yang berlaku.
segments.tr: - Sectoral minimum wages can apply to certain sectors, according to agreements and applicable regulations.

segments.src: Penting dipahami bahwa upah minimum ditujukan bagi pekerja dengan masa kerja kurang dari satu tahun.
segments.tr: It is important to understand that the minimum wage is intended for workers with a working period of less than one year.

segments.src: Bagi pekerja yang sudah lebih lama bekerja, upah seharusnya mengacu pada struktur dan skala upah di perusahaan.
segments.tr: For workers who have worked longer, wages should refer to the wage structure and scale in the company.

segments.src: ## Proses tahunan: siapa yang terlibat?
segments.tr: ## Annual process: who is involved?

segments.src: Pembahasan umumnya melibatkan **Dewan Pengupahan** di tingkat provinsi atau kabupaten/kota, yang terdiri atas unsur pemerintah, serikat pekerja, organisasi pengusaha, serta akademisi atau pakar.
segments.tr: Discussions generally involve the **Wage Council** at the provincial or regency/city level, which consists of government elements, labor unions, employer organizations, as well as academics or experts.

segments.src: Dewan ini memberikan rekomendasi kepada kepala daerah, yang kemudian menetapkan angka final.
segments.tr: This council provides recommendations to the regional head, who then determines the final figure.

segments.src: Data yang dipakai, seperti inflasi dan pertumbuhan ekonomi, bersumber dari lembaga statistik resmi.
segments.tr: The data used, such as inflation and economic growth, comes from official statistical institutions.

segments.src: ## Komponen utama formula
segments.tr: ## Main components of the formula

segments.src: Dalam kerangka pengupahan yang pernah dipakai beberapa tahun terakhir, penyesuaian upah minimum dihitung dari beberapa unsur berikut:
segments.tr: In the wage framework used in recent years, minimum wage adjustments are calculated from the following elements:

segments.src: 1. **Inflasi.** Mengukur kenaikan harga barang dan jasa. Tujuannya menjaga daya beli agar upah riil tidak tergerus. Inflasi pangan sering terasa lebih berat bagi rumah tangga berpenghasilan rendah karena porsi belanja makanan mereka lebih besar.
segments.tr: 1. **Inflation.** Measures the increase in the price of goods and services. The goal is to maintain purchasing power so that real wages are not eroded. Food inflation often feels heavier for low-income households because their food expenditure portion is larger.

segments.src: 2. **Pertumbuhan ekonomi.** Mencerminkan kemampuan ekonomi daerah atau nasional dalam menciptakan nilai tambah. Angka ini dianggap sebagai ruang bagi kenaikan upah tanpa membebani dunia usaha secara berlebihan.
segments.tr: 2. **Economic growth.** Reflects the ability of the regional or national economy to create added value. This figure is considered as room for wage increases without excessively burdening the business world.

segments.src: 3. **Indeks tertentu (sering disebut alfa).** Koefisien yang menentukan seberapa besar pertumbuhan ekonomi diperhitungkan dalam kenaikan upah. Rentang dan cara penentuannya bisa berubah mengikuti regulasi dan mempertimbangkan faktor seperti tingkat penyerapan tenaga kerja dan rata-rata atau median upah di daerah tersebut.
segments.tr: 3. **Certain index (often called alpha).** The coefficient that determines how much economic growth is taken into account in wage increases. The range and method of determination can change following regulations and considering factors such as the employment absorption rate and the average or median wage in the region.

segments.src: Secara sederhana, logikanya dapat digambarkan seperti ini:
segments.tr: Simply put, the logic can be illustrated like this:

segments.src: > Kenaikan upah minimum ≈ inflasi + (pertumbuhan ekonomi × indeks tertentu)
segments.tr: > Minimum wage increase ≈ inflation + (economic growth × certain index)

segments.src: Contoh ilustrasi (angka hipotetis, bukan prediksi): jika inflasi 2,5 persen, pertumbuhan ekonomi 5 persen, dan indeks tertentu 0,5, maka kenaikan sekitar 2,5 + (5 × 0,5) = 5 persen.
segments.tr: Illustration example (hypothetical figures, not predictions): if inflation is 2.5 percent, economic growth is 5 percent, and a certain index is 0.5, then the increase is about 2.5 + (5 × 0.5) = 5 percent.

segments.src: Angka sebenarnya bergantung pada data resmi dan aturan yang berlaku saat penetapan.
segments.tr: The actual figure depends on official data and the rules applicable at the time of determination.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Regulasi pengupahan dapat direvisi, termasuk sebagai tindak lanjut putusan Mahkamah Konstitusi dan pembahasan undang-undang ketenagakerjaan. Pembaca disarankan memeriksa peraturan terbaru dan pengumuman resmi pemerintah untuk ketentuan UMP 2027.
segments.tr: > **Note:** Wage regulations can be revised, including as a follow-up to the Constitutional Court decision and labor law discussions. Readers are advised to check the latest regulations and official government announcements for 2027 UMP provisions.

segments.src: ## Mengapa buruh dan pengusaha sering berbeda pandangan?
segments.tr: ## Why do workers and employers often have different views?

segments.src: Perbedaan pandangan biasanya bukan soal rumus semata, melainkan **cara menilai kondisi nyata**.
segments.tr: Differences in views are usually not about formulas alone, but rather **the way of assessing real conditions**.

segments.src: **Dari sisi pekerja dan serikat pekerja:**
segments.tr: **From the perspective of workers and labor unions:**

segments.src: - Kenaikan harga kebutuhan pokok, sewa tempat tinggal, transportasi, dan biaya pendidikan sering dirasakan lebih tinggi daripada angka inflasi umum.
segments.tr: - Increases in the prices of basic necessities, housing rent, transportation, and education costs are often felt to be higher than the general inflation figure.

segments.src: - Mereka menilai upah minimum perlu mencerminkan kebutuhan hidup layak, bukan sekadar bertahan.
segments.tr: - They consider that the minimum wage needs to reflect a decent living standard, not just survival.

segments.src: - Setelah beberapa tahun kenaikan yang dianggap kecil, ada kekhawatiran upah riil tertinggal.
segments.tr: - After several years of increases deemed small, there is concern that real wages are left behind.

segments.src: **Dari sisi pengusaha:**
segments.tr: **From the employers' perspective:**

segments.src: - Upah adalah salah satu komponen biaya terbesar, terutama bagi industri padat karya seperti tekstil, alas kaki, dan manufaktur.
segments.tr: - Wages are one of the largest cost components, especially for labor-intensive industries such as textiles, footwear, and manufacturing.

segments.src: - Permintaan yang melemah, biaya bahan baku, serta nilai tukar dapat menekan margin.
segments.tr: - Weakening demand, raw material costs, and exchange rates can pressure margins.

segments.src: - Kenaikan upah yang tajam dikhawatirkan memicu efisiensi, penundaan perekrutan, atau relokasi usaha.
segments.tr: - Sharp wage increases are feared to trigger efficiency, delayed hiring, or business relocation.

segments.src: - Usaha kecil dan menengah menekankan perlunya kepastian dan prediktabilitas aturan.
segments.tr: - Small and medium enterprises emphasize the need for certainty and predictability of rules.

segments.src: Kedua pandangan ini memiliki dasar.
segments.tr: Both views have a basis.

segments.src: Karena itu, proses dialog tripartit menjadi penting untuk mencari titik temu.
segments.tr: Therefore, the tripartite dialogue process is important to find common ground.

segments.src: ## Konteks tahun ini: PHK dan inflasi pangan
segments.tr: ## This year's context: layoffs and food inflation

segments.src: Dua isu sering muncul bersamaan dalam pembahasan:
segments.tr: Two issues often appear simultaneously in discussions:

segments.src: - **PHK.** Ketika sebagian sektor melakukan penyesuaian tenaga kerja, pengusaha cenderung berhati-hati terhadap kenaikan upah. Di sisi lain, pekerja yang masih bekerja khawatir daya belinya turun, sementara keluarga yang terdampak PHK bergantung pada pendapatan yang tersisa. Perlu dicatat bahwa PHK dipengaruhi banyak faktor, bukan hanya upah.
segments.tr: - **Layoffs.** When some sectors make workforce adjustments, employers tend to be cautious about wage increases. On the other hand, workers who are still employed worry their purchasing power will drop, while families affected by layoffs depend on the remaining income. It should be noted that layoffs are influenced by many factors, not just wages.

segments.src: - **Inflasi pangan.** Harga beras, cabai, minyak goreng, dan bahan pokok lain dapat berfluktuasi karena cuaca, distribusi, dan pasokan. Inflasi pangan yang tinggi menekan rumah tangga berpenghasilan rendah, sehingga dijadikan argumen untuk kenaikan upah yang memadai.
segments.tr: - **Food inflation.** The prices of rice, chili, cooking oil, and other basic materials can fluctuate due to weather, distribution, and supply. High food inflation presses low-income households, making it an argument for adequate wage increases.

segments.src: Pembaca sebaiknya membedakan antara **inflasi umum** yang dipakai dalam formula dan **pengalaman belanja pribadi** yang bisa berbeda.
segments.tr: Readers should distinguish between **general inflation** used in the formula and **personal shopping experiences** which can differ.

segments.src: Keduanya sah, tetapi tidak selalu sama.
segments.tr: Both are valid, but not always the same.

segments.src: ## Cara membaca pengumuman UMP dengan kritis
segments.tr: ## How to read UMP announcements critically

segments.src: Saat angka UMP diumumkan, beberapa pertanyaan berikut dapat membantu:
segments.tr: When UMP figures are announced, the following questions can help:

segments.src: 1. **Berapa persen kenaikannya dan dari basis apa?** Bandingkan nominal dan persentase.
segments.tr: 1. **What is the percentage increase and from what base?** Compare the nominal and percentage.

segments.src: 2. **Data apa yang dipakai?** Periksa periode inflasi dan pertumbuhan ekonomi yang menjadi acuan.
segments.tr: 2. **What data is used?** Check the inflation and economic growth period that serves as the reference.

segments.src: 3. **Apakah ada UMK atau upah sektoral?** Di banyak daerah, upah yang berlaku lebih tinggi daripada UMP.
segments.tr: 3. **Are there UMK or sectoral wages?** In many regions, the applicable wages are higher than the UMP.

segments.src: 4. **Bagaimana dengan daerah lain?** Perbedaan antarprovinsi mencerminkan perbedaan biaya hidup dan struktur ekonomi.
segments.tr: 4. **How about other regions?** Inter-provincial differences reflect differences in the cost of living and economic structure.

segments.src: 5. **Kapan mulai berlaku?** Umumnya awal tahun berikutnya, dengan pengawasan dari dinas ketenagakerjaan.
segments.tr: 5. **When does it take effect?** Generally at the beginning of the next year, with supervision from the manpower office.

segments.src: ## Yang bisa dilakukan pekerja dan pengusaha
segments.tr: ## What workers and employers can do

segments.src: - **Pekerja:** Pahami komponen slip gaji, cek apakah upah pokok sudah sesuai ketentuan, dan manfaatkan jalur bipartit atau serikat untuk berdialog.
segments.tr: - **Workers:** Understand the payslip components, check if the basic wage is in accordance with regulations, and utilize bipartite channels or unions for dialogue.

segments.src: - **Pengusaha:** Rencanakan anggaran tenaga kerja lebih awal, komunikasikan kebijakan secara terbuka, dan manfaatkan peningkatan produktivitas sebagai pelengkap strategi pengupahan.
segments.tr: - **Employers:** Plan labor budgets earlier, communicate policies openly, and utilize productivity increases as a complement to the wage strategy.

segments.src: - **Keduanya:** Pelatihan keterampilan dan peningkatan produktivitas dapat membantu menjaga daya saing sekaligus kesejahteraan.
segments.tr: - **Both:** Skills training and productivity improvement can help maintain competitiveness as well as welfare.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Formula upah minimum adalah upaya menyeimbangkan dua tujuan: melindungi daya beli pekerja dan menjaga keberlangsungan usaha serta penciptaan lapangan kerja.
segments.tr: The minimum wage formula is an effort to balance two goals: protecting workers' purchasing power and maintaining business continuity and job creation.

segments.src: Di tengah PHK dan inflasi pangan, tarik-menarik kepentingan memang wajar.
segments.tr: Amid layoffs and food inflation, the tug-of-war of interests is indeed natural.

segments.src: Memahami komponen formula membantu masyarakat menilai pengumuman UMP 2027 secara lebih tenang dan berbasis data.
segments.tr: Understanding the formula components helps the public assess the 2027 UMP announcement more calmly and data-based.

segments.src: *Artikel ini bersifat informatif dan bukan nasihat hukum atau keuangan.
segments.tr: *This article is informative and not legal or financial advice.

segments.src: Angka dalam contoh adalah ilustrasi.
segments.tr: Figures in the examples are illustrations.

segments.src: Untuk ketentuan resmi, rujuk pengumuman pemerintah dan peraturan yang berlaku.*
segments.tr: For official provisions, refer to government announcements and applicable regulations.*

id-20261009-intro-logistics-6.title: [Logistics #6] The Cheapest Supplier Is Often the Most Expensive: How Procurement Works

segments.src: > Pengadaan bukan soal menawar harga sampai serendah mungkin, tapi soal memilih dan merawat pemasok agar biaya total, risiko, dan kualitas tetap terkendali.
segments.tr: > Procurement isn't about haggling the price as low as possible, but about choosing and managing suppliers so total cost, risk, and quality stay under control.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Di seri "Pengantar Manajemen Logistik & Rantai Pasok" ini, kita sudah bicara soal aliran barang.
segments.tr: In this "Introduction to Logistics & Supply Chain Management" series, we've already talked about the flow of goods.

segments.src: Hari ini kita mundur satu langkah ke titik paling awal: **dari mana barangnya datang?**
segments.tr: Today we step back one level to the very starting point: **where do the goods come from?**

segments.src: Dua kata yang sering ditukar padahal beda:
segments.tr: Two terms that are often mixed up even though they differ:

segments.src: - **Pembelian (*purchasing*)** — kegiatan transaksionalnya: bikin PO, terima barang, cocokkan faktur, bayar.
segments.tr: - **Purchasing (*pembelian*)** — the transactional activity: creating POs, receiving goods, matching invoices, paying.

segments.src: - **Pengadaan (*procurement*)** — siklus lengkapnya: identifikasi kebutuhan → susun spesifikasi → cari dan seleksi pemasok → negosiasi → kontrak → kelola kinerja pemasok → evaluasi ulang.
segments.tr: - **Procurement (*pengadaan*)** — the full cycle: identifying needs → drafting specifications → finding and selecting suppliers → negotiation → contract → managing supplier performance → re-evaluation.

segments.src: Pembelian adalah satu potongan dari pengadaan.
segments.tr: Purchasing is one piece of procurement.

segments.src: Perusahaan yang hanya jago "pembelian" akan sibuk menekan harga per unit.
segments.tr: A company that is only good at "purchasing" will be busy pushing down the price per unit.

segments.src: Perusahaan yang jago "pengadaan" bertanya lebih dulu: barang ini sebenarnya perlu tidak?
segments.tr: A company that is good at "procurement" asks first: does this item actually need to be bought?

segments.src: spesifikasinya kelewat mewah tidak?
segments.tr: is the specification unnecessarily luxurious?

segments.src: lebih baik dibuat sendiri atau dibeli?
segments.tr: is it better to make it in-house or buy it?

segments.src: **Empat hal inti yang dikerjakan bagian pengadaan:**
segments.tr: **Four core tasks handled by the procurement function:**

segments.src: Seleksi pemasok.** Kriteria klasiknya QCD — *Quality, Cost, Delivery* — plus kapasitas produksi, kesehatan keuangan, kepatuhan legal, dan (makin penting) keberlanjutan.
segments.tr: Supplier selection.** The classic criteria are QCD — *Quality, Cost, Delivery* — plus production capacity, financial health, legal compliance, and (increasingly important) sustainability.

segments.src: Alatnya: RFI (minta informasi), RFQ (minta penawaran harga), RFP (minta proposal solusi), lalu penilaian berbobot.
segments.tr: The tools: RFI (request for information), RFQ (request for quotation), RFP (request for proposal), then weighted scoring.

segments.src: Strategi sourcing.** Beli dari satu pemasok (*single sourcing*) memberi harga lebih baik lewat volume dan hubungan yang dalam, tapi rapuh kalau pemasok itu kena banjir, mogok, atau bangkrut.
segments.tr: Sourcing strategy.** Buying from a single supplier (*single sourcing*) gives better prices through volume and deep relationships, but is fragile if that supplier is hit by flooding, a strike, or bankruptcy.

segments.src: Beli dari beberapa pemasok (*multiple sourcing*) lebih aman tapi lebih mahal dan lebih repot dikelola.
segments.tr: Buying from several suppliers (*multiple sourcing*) is safer but more expensive and more cumbersome to manage.

segments.src: Tidak ada jawaban benar universal — jawabannya tergantung barangnya.
segments.tr: There is no universally correct answer — it depends on the item.

segments.src: Untuk memilah barangnya, praktisi memakai **Matriks Kraljic**, yang membagi belanja ke empat kotak berdasarkan (a) besar nilai belanja dan (b) tingkat risiko pasokan:
segments.tr: To sort items, practitioners use the **Kraljic Matrix**, which divides spend into four quadrants based on (a) the size of spend value and (b) the level of supply risk:

segments.src: | | Risiko pasokan rendah | Risiko pasokan tinggi |
segments.tr: | | Low supply risk | High supply risk |

segments.src: | **Nilai belanja tinggi** | *Leverage* — tender, adu harga | *Strategis* — kemitraan jangka panjang |
segments.tr: | **High spend value** | *Leverage* — tenders, price competition | *Strategic* — long-term partnerships |

segments.src: | **Nilai belanja rendah** | *Rutin* — otomatisasi, e-katalog | *Bottleneck* — amankan stok, cari substitusi |
segments.tr: | **Low spend value** | *Routine* — automation, e-catalogs | *Bottleneck* — secure stock, find substitutes |

segments.src: Keputusan buat-atau-beli (*make-or-buy*) dan outsourcing.<b> Aktivitas yang bukan keunggulan inti perusahaan biasanya lebih murah dan lebih cepat kalau diserahkan ke pihak ketiga — misalnya pengiriman ke 3PL.
segments.tr: Make-or-buy decisions and outsourcing.<b> Activities that are not a company's core competency are usually cheaper and faster when handed to a third party — for example, shipping to a 3PL.

segments.src: Tapi outsourcing memindahkan pekerjaan, bukan** memindahkan tanggung jawab: kalau paket telat, pelanggan tetap menyalahkan merek Anda.
segments.tr: But outsourcing moves the work, not** the responsibility: if a parcel is late, customers still blame your brand.

segments.src: Karena itu outsourcing selalu perlu SLA (janji tingkat layanan) yang terukur.
segments.tr: That's why outsourcing always needs measurable SLAs (service level agreements).

segments.src: SRM (*Supplier Relationship Management*).** Setelah kontrak diteken, pekerjaan justru dimulai: menilai kinerja pemasok secara berkala (*vendor scorecard*), memberi umpan balik, membantu pemasok kecil memperbaiki proses, dan menaikkan pemasok terbaik jadi mitra pengembangan produk.
segments.tr: SRM (*Supplier Relationship Management*).** Once the contract is signed, the real work begins: regularly assessing supplier performance (*vendor scorecard*), giving feedback, helping small suppliers improve their processes, and elevating the best suppliers into product development partners.

segments.src: Menekan harga pemasok terus-menerus sering berakhir dengan pemasok memotong kualitas diam-diam.
segments.tr: Constantly squeezing supplier prices often ends with the supplier quietly cutting quality.

segments.src: Benang merah dari semuanya adalah **TCO (*Total Cost of Ownership*)** — biaya sesungguhnya dari sebuah keputusan beli, bukan sekadar harga di penawaran:
segments.tr: The common thread through all of this is **TCO (*Total Cost of Ownership*)** — the actual cost of a buying decision, not just the price on the quote:

segments.src: TCO = harga beli + ongkos kirim + bea/pajak + biaya simpan
segments.tr: TCO = harga beli + ongkos kirim + bea/pajak + biaya simpan

segments.src: + biaya cacat & rework + biaya keterlambatan + biaya risiko pasokan
segments.tr: + biaya cacat & rework + biaya keterlambatan + biaya risiko pasokan

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Everyday Practice

segments.src: Bayangkan **Kopi Senja**, jaringan kedai kopi dengan 12 gerai di Jabodetabek, yang memakai sekitar **200.000 gelas plastik per bulan**.
segments.tr: Imagine **Kopi Senja**, a coffee shop chain with 12 outlets in Greater Jakarta, using about **200,000 plastic cups per month**.

segments.src: (Angka di bawah ilustrasi, tapi polanya nyata.)
segments.tr: (The numbers are illustrative, but the pattern is real.)

segments.src: Ada dua penawaran:
segments.tr: There are two offers:

segments.src: **Pemasok A — Bekasi**
segments.tr: **Supplier A — Bekasi**

segments.src: Rp 1.150/gelas, gratis ongkir, lead time 3 hari, tingkat cacat 0,3%.
segments.tr: Rp 1,150/cup, free shipping, 3-day lead time, 0.3% defect rate.

segments.src: **Pemasok B — Surabaya**
segments.tr: **Supplier B — Surabaya**

segments.src: Rp 1.050/gelas, MOQ 100.000 pcs, ongkir Rp 3 juta per 100.000 pcs, lead time 21 hari, tingkat cacat 2%.
segments.tr: Rp 1,050/cup, MOQ 100,000 pcs, shipping Rp 3 million per 100,000 pcs, 21-day lead time, 2% defect rate.

segments.src: Manajer yang hanya melihat harga satuan akan langsung pilih B: hemat Rp 100 per gelas, berarti **Rp 20 juta sebulan**.
segments.tr: A manager who only looks at unit price would immediately pick B: saving Rp 100 per cup means **Rp 20 million a month**.

segments.src: Kelihatannya menang telak.
segments.tr: It looks like a clear win.

segments.src: Sekarang hitung dengan kacamata TCO:
segments.tr: Now calculate through the TCO lens:

segments.src: - **Pemasok A:** 200.000 × Rp 1.150 = **Rp 230 juta**. Cacat 0,3% ≈ 600 gelas, dampaknya kecil.
segments.tr: - **Supplier A:** 200,000 × Rp 1,150 = **Rp 230 million**. Defects of 0.3% ≈ 600 cups, a small impact.

segments.src: - **Pemasok B:** 200.000 × Rp 1.050 = Rp 210 juta, tambah ongkir Rp 6 juta = **Rp 216 juta**. Tapi cacat 2% = **4.000 gelas bocor**. Sebagian ketahuan sebelum dipakai, sebagian baru bocor setelah diisi es kopi susu — dan satu gelas bocor di tangan pelanggan berarti minuman dibuang, dibuatkan ulang, plus ulasan bintang satu. Kalau sekitar setengahnya bocor setelah diisi dan HPP satu minuman Rp 8.000, kerugian itu saja ≈ Rp 16 juta.
segments.tr: - **Supplier B:** 200,000 × Rp 1,050 = Rp 210 million, plus Rp 6 million shipping = **Rp 216 million**. But 2% defects = **4,000 leaking cups**. Some are caught before use, others only leak after being filled with iced milk coffee — and a cup leaking in a customer's hand means the drink is thrown away, remade, plus a one-star review. If about half leak after filling and the COGS of one drink is Rp 8,000, that loss alone ≈ Rp 16 million.

segments.src: Belum selesai.
segments.tr: Not finished yet.

segments.src: MOQ 100.000 pcs memaksa Kopi Senja menyimpan stok jauh lebih banyak — gudang kecil di belakang gerai penuh, uang mengendap di persediaan.
segments.tr: The MOQ of 100,000 pcs forces Kopi Senja to store far more stock — the small warehouse behind the outlets is full, and money is tied up in inventory.

segments.src: Lead time 21 hari berarti kalau permintaan melonjak saat libur Lebaran, tidak ada opsi pesan cepat.
segments.tr: A 21-day lead time means that if demand spikes during Lebaran, there is no option for rush orders.

segments.src: Jadi penawaran yang di atas kertas lebih murah Rp 20 juta, dalam praktiknya bisa **lebih mahal**.
segments.tr: So an offer that looks Rp 20 million cheaper on paper can in practice turn out to be **more expensive**.

segments.src: Ini bukan alasan untuk selalu memilih pemasok lokal yang mahal — intinya: bandingkan biaya total, jangan bandingkan angka di kolom harga saja.
segments.tr: This is not a reason to always choose expensive local suppliers — the point is: compare total cost, don't compare only the numbers in the price column.

segments.src: Lalu ke mana Kraljic-nya?
segments.tr: So where does Kraljic come in?

segments.src: Bagi belanja Kopi Senja:
segments.tr: Sorting Kopi Senja's spend:

segments.src: - **Rutin:** tisu, sedotan, sarung tangan → beli lewat e-katalog, otomatisasi, jangan buang waktu rapat.
segments.tr: - **Routine:** tissues, straws, gloves → buy via e-catalog, automate, don't waste time in meetings.

segments.src: - **Leverage:** gelas plastik, gula, susu UHT → banyak pemasok, nilai besar, cocok ditenderkan tiap 6–12 bulan.
segments.tr: - **Leverage:** plastic cups, sugar, UHT milk → many suppliers, high value, suitable for tendering every 6–12 months.

segments.src: - **Bottleneck:** sparepart mesin espresso impor → nilainya kecil tapi kalau tidak ada, gerai tutup. Simpan stok pengaman, cari teknisi cadangan.
segments.tr: - **Bottleneck:** imported espresso machine spare parts → small value, but without them outlets close. Keep safety stock, find backup technicians.

segments.src: - **Strategis:** *green bean* Arabika Gayo single origin yang jadi identitas rasa mereka → jangan ditender adu harga. Bangun kontrak musiman dengan koperasi petani, bantu perbaiki proses pascapanen, kunci pasokan panen berikutnya. Ini wilayah SRM.
segments.tr: - **Strategic:** Gayo single-origin Arabica *green beans* that define their flavor identity → don't tender on price. Build seasonal contracts with farmer cooperatives, help improve post-harvest processes, lock in the next harvest's supply. This is SRM territory.

segments.src: Terakhir, make-or-buy: Kopi Senja memilih **tidak** membeli mesin sangrai sendiri (investasi ratusan juta, butuh *roaster* terlatih) dan memakai jasa *toll roasting*; pengantaran antargerai diserahkan ke penyedia logistik pihak ketiga dengan SLA "tiba sebelum jam 07.00, ketepatan ≥ 97%".
segments.tr: Finally, make-or-buy: Kopi Senja chose **not** to buy its own roasting machine (an investment of hundreds of millions, requiring trained roasters) and uses *toll roasting* services; inter-outlet deliveries are handed to a third-party logistics provider with an SLA of "arrives before 07:00, on-time rate ≥ 97%".

segments.src: Yang tetap mereka pegang sendiri: resep, pemilihan biji, dan hubungan dengan koperasi petani — karena di situlah keunggulan mereka.
segments.tr: What they keep in-house: recipes, bean selection, and relationships with farmer cooperatives — because that is where their competitive advantage lies.

segments.src: Konteks Indonesia: kalau Anda bekerja di instansi pemerintah atau BUMN, logika yang sama muncul dalam bentuk regulasi — pengadaan lewat SPSE dan e-katalog LKPP, serta kewajiban memperhatikan **TKDN** (Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri).
segments.tr: Indonesian context: if you work at a government agency or SOE (BUMN), the same logic appears in the form of regulations — procurement through SPSE and the LKPP e-catalog, and the obligation to consider **TKDN** (Domestic Component Level).

segments.src: Bentuknya formal, tapi pertanyaan dasarnya identik: pemasok mana yang memberi nilai terbaik untuk uang yang dikeluarkan, dengan risiko yang bisa diterima.
segments.tr: The forms are formal, but the basic question is identical: which supplier delivers the best value for money spent, with acceptable risk.

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Pembelian itu transaksi (PO–terima–bayar); pengadaan itu siklus penuh dari menentukan kebutuhan sampai mengevaluasi kinerja pemasok.
segments.tr: 1. Purchasing is a transaction (PO–receive–pay); procurement is the full cycle from determining needs to evaluating supplier performance.

segments.src: 2. Pilih pemasok berdasarkan **TCO** — harga beli hanyalah satu komponen; cacat, lead time, MOQ, dan risiko pasokan sering lebih mahal dari selisih harga.
segments.tr: 2. Choose suppliers based on **TCO** — the purchase price is only one component; defects, lead time, MOQ, and supply risk often cost more than the price difference.

segments.src: 3. Perlakukan setiap kategori belanja berbeda (Kraljic): tender untuk *leverage*, kemitraan untuk barang strategis, otomatisasi untuk barang rutin, stok pengaman untuk *bottleneck*.
segments.tr: 3. Treat each spend category differently (Kraljic): tender for *leverage*, partnerships for strategic items, automation for routine items, safety stock for *bottlenecks*.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Mana pernyataan yang paling tepat soal beda *procurement* dan *purchasing*?
segments.tr: **1.** Which statement best describes the difference between *procurement* and *purchasing*?

segments.src: - (A) Keduanya sama, hanya beda istilah Inggris dan Indonesia
segments.tr: - (A) They are the same; just different English and Indonesian terms

segments.src: - (B) *Purchasing* adalah bagian transaksional di dalam *procurement* yang cakupannya lebih luas
segments.tr: - (B) *Purchasing* is the transactional part within *procurement*, which has a broader scope

segments.src: - (C) *Procurement* hanya untuk jasa, *purchasing* hanya untuk barang
segments.tr: - (C) *Procurement* is only for services, *purchasing* is only for goods

segments.src: - (D) *Procurement* dilakukan pemerintah, *purchasing* dilakukan swasta
segments.tr: - (D) *Procurement* is done by government, *purchasing* is done by the private sector

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) Pemasok dengan harga satuan termurah selalu menghasilkan biaya total terendah bagi perusahaan.
segments.tr: **2.** (T/F) The supplier with the lowest unit price always results in the lowest total cost for the company.

segments.src: **3.** Sebuah pabrik membeli satu jenis sensor impor: nilai belanjanya kecil, tapi hanya ada satu produsen di dunia dan tanpa sensor itu lini produksi berhenti.
segments.tr: **3.** A factory buys one type of imported sensor: its spend value is small, but there is only one manufacturer in the world, and without that sensor the production line stops.

segments.src: Dalam Matriks Kraljic, sensor ini masuk kategori?
segments.tr: In the Kraljic Matrix, this sensor falls into which category?

segments.src: - (A) Rutin (*non-critical*)
segments.tr: - (A) Routine (*non-critical*)

segments.src: - (B) *Leverage*
segments.tr: - (B) *Leverage*

segments.src: - (C) *Bottleneck*
segments.tr: - (C) *Bottleneck*

segments.src: - (D) Strategis
segments.tr: - (D) Strategic

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Pengadaan (*procurement*)** — seluruh proses memperoleh barang/jasa, dari analisis kebutuhan, seleksi pemasok, kontrak, sampai evaluasi kinerja.
segments.tr: - **Procurement (*pengadaan*)** — the entire process of acquiring goods/services, from needs analysis, supplier selection, and contracts, to performance evaluation.

segments.src: - **TCO (*Total Cost of Ownership*)** — total biaya kepemilikan: harga beli ditambah ongkir, penyimpanan, cacat, keterlambatan, dan risiko pasokan.
segments.tr: - **TCO (*Total Cost of Ownership*)** — total cost of ownership: purchase price plus shipping, storage, defects, delays, and supply risk.

segments.src: - **Single vs multiple sourcing** — strategi memakai satu pemasok (efisien tapi rapuh) versus beberapa pemasok (aman tapi lebih mahal dikelola).
segments.tr: - **Single vs multiple sourcing** — the strategy of using one supplier (efficient but fragile) versus several suppliers (safe but more expensive to manage).

segments.src: - **Matriks Kraljic** — kerangka memilah kategori belanja berdasarkan nilai belanja dan risiko pasokan menjadi empat kuadran, masing-masing dengan strategi berbeda.
segments.tr: - **Kraljic Matrix** — a framework for sorting spend categories by spend value and supply risk into four quadrants, each with a different strategy.

segments.src: - **SRM (*Supplier Relationship Management*)** — pengelolaan hubungan pemasok setelah kontrak: penilaian kinerja berkala, umpan balik, dan pengembangan pemasok.
segments.tr: - **SRM (*Supplier Relationship Management*)** — managing supplier relationships after the contract: periodic performance assessment, feedback, and supplier development.

segments.src: - **SLA (*Service Level Agreement*)** — janji tingkat layanan yang terukur (misalnya ketepatan kirim ≥ 97%), wajib ada saat mengalihdayakan pekerjaan.
segments.tr: - **SLA (*Service Level Agreement*)** — measurable service-level commitments (e.g., on-time delivery ≥ 97%), mandatory when outsourcing work.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) **B** — purchasing adalah aktivitas transaksional (PO, penerimaan, pembayaran) di dalam siklus procurement yang mencakup penentuan kebutuhan, sourcing, kontrak, hingga evaluasi pemasok.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) **B** — purchasing is the transactional activity (PO, receiving, payment) within the procurement cycle, which covers determining needs, sourcing, contracts, through supplier evaluation.

segments.src: 2) **X (salah)** — seperti kasus Kopi Senja, harga satuan lebih murah Rp 100 bisa kalah oleh biaya cacat 2%, ongkir, MOQ besar, dan lead time 21 hari; yang dibandingkan seharusnya TCO.
segments.tr: 2) **F (false)** — as in the Kopi Senja case, a unit price that is Rp 100 cheaper can be outweighed by 2% defect costs, shipping, large MOQ, and a 21-day lead time; the comparison should be TCO.

segments.src: 3) **C** — nilai belanja rendah tapi risiko pasokan tinggi = bottleneck; strateginya mengamankan pasokan (stok pengaman, kontrak pasokan, mencari komponen substitusi), bukan mengadu harga.*
segments.tr: 3) **C** — low spend value but high supply risk = bottleneck; the strategy is to secure supply (safety stock, supply contracts, finding substitute components), not to compete on price.*

id-20261009-news-2.title: IMF–World Bank Annual Meetings October 2026: What Global Economic Projections Mean for Indonesia

segments.src: Setiap Oktober, para menteri keuangan, gubernur bank sentral, ekonom, dan pelaku pasar dari berbagai negara berkumpul dalam Pertemuan Tahunan IMF–Bank Dunia.
segments.tr: Every October, finance ministers, central bank governors, economists, and market participants from various countries gather for the IMF–World Bank Annual Meetings.

segments.src: Forum ini bukan sekadar agenda seremonial.
segments.tr: This forum is not merely a ceremonial agenda.

segments.src: Di sela-sela pertemuan, IMF biasanya merilis laporan *World Economic Outlook* (WEO) dan *Global Financial Stability Report*, yang memuat proyeksi pertumbuhan, inflasi, serta peringatan risiko terhadap stabilitas keuangan global.
segments.tr: On the sidelines of the meetings, the IMF typically releases the *World Economic Outlook* (WEO) and *Global Financial Stability Report*, which contain growth projections, inflation forecasts, and risk warnings regarding global financial stability.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia sebagai ekonomi terbuka yang terhubung dengan perdagangan dan pasar keuangan dunia, isi laporan tersebut patut dicermati.
segments.tr: For Indonesia as an open economy connected to world trade and financial markets, the contents of these reports are worth closely examining.

segments.src: Artikel ini menguraikan secara umum bagaimana tiga faktor utama, yaitu harga minyak, suku bunga Amerika Serikat, dan arus modal, dapat memengaruhi perekonomian Indonesia.
segments.tr: This article outlines in general how three main factors—oil prices, United States interest rates, and capital flows—can affect the Indonesian economy.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan saran investasi atau keuangan. Angka proyeksi terbaru sebaiknya diperiksa langsung pada publikasi resmi IMF, Bank Dunia, Bank Indonesia, dan Kementerian Keuangan.
segments.tr: > **Note:** This article is for general informational purposes and does not constitute investment or financial advice. The latest projection figures should be checked directly in the official publications of the IMF, World Bank, Bank Indonesia, and the Ministry of Finance.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Pertemuan Ini Penting?
segments.tr: ## Why Are These Meetings Important?

segments.src: Ada beberapa alasan mengapa forum ini diperhatikan luas:
segments.tr: There are several reasons why this forum receives widespread attention:

segments.src: - **Revisi proyeksi pertumbuhan.** IMF secara berkala menyesuaikan perkiraan pertumbuhan ekonomi dunia dan tiap negara. Revisi naik atau turun sering menjadi acuan bagi pemerintah, dunia usaha, dan investor.
segments.tr: - **Growth projection revisions.** The IMF periodically adjusts its forecasts for global economic growth and individual countries. Upward or downward revisions often serve as a reference for governments, businesses, and investors.

segments.src: - **Peringatan risiko.** Laporan stabilitas keuangan biasanya menyoroti kerentanan, misalnya tingkat utang yang tinggi, tekanan di pasar obligasi, ketegangan perdagangan, atau gejolak geopolitik.
segments.tr: - **Risk warnings.** Financial stability reports typically highlight vulnerabilities, such as high debt levels, bond market pressures, trade tensions, or geopolitical turmoil.

segments.src: - **Koordinasi kebijakan.** Pertemuan ini menjadi ruang dialog antarnegara mengenai kebijakan fiskal, moneter, dan dukungan bagi negara berkembang.
segments.tr: - **Policy coordination.** The meetings serve as a space for intergovernmental dialogue regarding fiscal policy, monetary policy, and support for developing nations.

segments.src: Perlu diingat, proyeksi bukanlah ramalan pasti.
segments.tr: Keep in mind that projections are not definitive forecasts.

segments.src: Angka-angka tersebut disusun berdasarkan asumsi yang bisa berubah jika kondisi global bergeser.
segments.tr: These figures are compiled based on assumptions that can change if global conditions shift.

segments.src: ## 1. Harga Minyak: Dua Sisi bagi Indonesia
segments.tr: ## 1. Oil Prices: Two Sides for Indonesia

segments.src: Harga minyak dunia memengaruhi Indonesia melalui beberapa jalur sekaligus.
segments.tr: World oil prices affect Indonesia through several channels simultaneously.

segments.src: **Sisi pengeluaran.** Indonesia merupakan importir neto minyak.
segments.tr: **Expenditure side.** Indonesia is a net oil importer.

segments.src: Ketika harga minyak naik, kebutuhan devisa untuk impor energi meningkat dan dapat menekan neraca perdagangan serta nilai tukar rupiah.
segments.tr: When oil prices rise, foreign exchange requirements for energy imports increase and can put pressure on the trade balance and the rupiah exchange rate.

segments.src: Kenaikan harga juga berpotensi menambah beban subsidi dan kompensasi energi dalam APBN, atau mendorong penyesuaian harga bahan bakar yang pada akhirnya berdampak ke inflasi.
segments.tr: Price increases also have the potential to add to the burden of energy subsidies and compensation in the state budget, or prompt fuel price adjustments that ultimately impact inflation.

segments.src: **Sisi penerimaan.** Di sisi lain, Indonesia juga mengekspor komoditas energi seperti batu bara dan gas.
segments.tr: **Revenue side.** On the other hand, Indonesia also exports energy commodities such as coal and gas.

segments.src: Harga energi yang lebih tinggi dapat mendorong penerimaan ekspor dan pajak dari sektor tersebut.
segments.tr: Higher energy prices can boost export revenues and tax receipts from these sectors.

segments.src: **Yang perlu dicermati:**
segments.tr: **What to watch:**

segments.src: - Apakah IMF mengubah asumsi harga minyak dan komoditas dalam proyeksinya.
segments.tr: - Whether the IMF changes its oil and commodity price assumptions in its projections.

segments.src: - Faktor yang memengaruhi pasokan, seperti keputusan produsen minyak dan kondisi geopolitik.
segments.tr: - Factors affecting supply, such as decisions by oil producers and geopolitical conditions.

segments.src: - Respons kebijakan pemerintah terhadap harga energi, termasuk soal subsidi dan harga eceran.
segments.tr: - Government policy responses to energy prices, including regarding subsidies and retail prices.

segments.src: Dampak bersihnya bergantung pada besarnya perubahan harga, lamanya, serta kebijakan penyangga yang diambil.
segments.tr: The net impact depends on the magnitude of the price change, its duration, and the buffer policies implemented.

segments.src: ## 2. Suku Bunga AS: Pengaruh pada Rupiah dan Biaya Pinjaman
segments.tr: ## 2. US Interest Rates: Influence on the Rupiah and Borrowing Costs

segments.src: Kebijakan suku bunga bank sentral AS, The Federal Reserve, sering disebut sebagai salah satu faktor eksternal terpenting bagi negara berkembang.
segments.tr: The interest rate policy of the US central bank, The Federal Reserve, is often cited as one of the most important external factors for developing countries.

segments.src: - **Suku bunga AS lebih tinggi lebih lama** cenderung memperkuat dolar AS dan membuat aset berdenominasi dolar lebih menarik. Akibatnya, tekanan terhadap mata uang negara berkembang, termasuk rupiah, dapat meningkat.
segments.tr: - **Higher for longer US interest rates** tend to strengthen the US dollar and make dollar-denominated assets more attractive. As a result, pressure on developing country currencies, including the rupiah, may increase.

segments.src: - **Pelonggaran suku bunga AS** umumnya mengurangi tekanan tersebut dan memberi ruang lebih luas bagi bank sentral lain untuk menyesuaikan kebijakannya.
segments.tr: - **US interest rate easing** generally reduces this pressure and provides more room for other central banks to adjust their policies.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, ada beberapa implikasi:
segments.tr: For Indonesia, there are several implications:

segments.src: 1. **Kebijakan Bank Indonesia.** Bank Indonesia harus menyeimbangkan stabilitas nilai tukar, pengendalian inflasi, dan dukungan terhadap pertumbuhan. Selisih suku bunga dalam negeri dan AS menjadi salah satu pertimbangan.
segments.tr: 1. **Bank Indonesia policy.** Bank Indonesia must balance exchange rate stability, inflation control, and support for growth. The interest rate differential between domestic rates and the US is one consideration.

segments.src: 2. **Biaya pembiayaan.** Imbal hasil obligasi AS yang tinggi dapat mendorong naiknya imbal hasil surat utang negara dan biaya pinjaman korporasi, terutama yang berdenominasi valuta asing.
segments.tr: 2. **Financing costs.** High US bond yields can drive up yields on government securities and corporate borrowing costs, especially those denominated in foreign currencies.

segments.src: 3. **Beban utang luar negeri.** Perusahaan dan pemerintah dengan utang dalam dolar akan merasakan beban lebih berat saat rupiah melemah.
segments.tr: 3. **Foreign debt burden.** Companies and governments with dollar-denominated debt will feel a heavier burden when the rupiah depreciates.

segments.src: Karena itu, pernyataan IMF mengenai arah kebijakan moneter negara maju dan risikonya terhadap pasar keuangan layak diperhatikan.
segments.tr: Therefore, the IMF's statements regarding the direction of advanced economy monetary policy and its risks to financial markets are worth noting.

segments.src: ## 3. Arus Modal: Antara Peluang dan Kerentanan
segments.tr: ## 3. Capital Flows: Between Opportunity and Vulnerability

segments.src: Arus modal asing masuk ke pasar saham dan obligasi Indonesia dapat membantu pembiayaan dan menopang nilai tukar.
segments.tr: Foreign capital inflows into Indonesia's stock and bond markets can help finance needs and support the exchange rate.

segments.src: Namun, arus ini juga bisa berbalik cepat ketika sentimen global memburuk.
segments.tr: However, these flows can also reverse quickly when global sentiment deteriorates.

segments.src: **Faktor yang biasanya memengaruhi arus modal:**
segments.tr: **Factors that typically affect capital flows:**

segments.src: - Selisih imbal hasil antara aset Indonesia dan aset negara maju
segments.tr: - Yield differentials between Indonesian assets and advanced economy assets

segments.src: - Persepsi risiko global dan pergerakan dolar AS
segments.tr: - Global risk perception and US dollar movements

segments.src: - Prospek pertumbuhan, stabilitas inflasi, dan kredibilitas kebijakan fiskal
segments.tr: - Growth prospects, inflation stability, and fiscal policy credibility

segments.src: - Peringkat dan kondisi fundamental ekonomi domestik
segments.tr: - Domestic economic ratings and fundamental conditions

segments.src: Indonesia memiliki beberapa penopang, seperti cadangan devisa, kerangka kebijakan moneter dan fiskal yang relatif berhati-hati, serta pasar domestik yang besar.
segments.tr: Indonesia has several buffers, such as foreign exchange reserves, a relatively prudent monetary and fiscal policy framework, and a large domestic market.

segments.src: Meski demikian, pasar keuangan tetap dapat bergejolak dalam jangka pendek ketika terjadi perubahan sentimen global.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, financial markets can still experience short-term volatility when global sentiment shifts.

segments.src: ## Apa Dampaknya bagi Masyarakat dan Dunia Usaha?
segments.tr: ## What Is the Impact for the Public and Businesses?

segments.src: Proyeksi global terdengar abstrak, tetapi dampaknya bisa terasa dalam kehidupan sehari-hari:
segments.tr: Global projections sound abstract, but their impacts can be felt in daily life:

segments.src: - **Rumah tangga:** Pelemahan rupiah dapat memengaruhi harga barang impor dan bahan baku. Perubahan suku bunga memengaruhi cicilan kredit dan imbal hasil tabungan.
segments.tr: - **Households:** Rupiah depreciation can affect the prices of imported goods and raw materials. Interest rate changes affect credit installments and savings yields.

segments.src: - **Pelaku usaha:** Eksportir dan importir perlu memperhatikan risiko nilai tukar. Perusahaan dengan utang valas biasanya mempertimbangkan lindung nilai.
segments.tr: - **Businesses:** Exporters and importers need to watch exchange rate risks. Companies with foreign currency debt typically consider hedging.

segments.src: - **Pekerja dan pencari kerja:** Perlambatan ekonomi global dapat memengaruhi permintaan ekspor dan investasi, yang berkaitan dengan lapangan kerja di sektor tertentu.
segments.tr: - **Workers and job seekers:** Global economic slowdowns can affect export demand and investment, which relate to employment in certain sectors.

segments.src: - **Investor ritel:** Volatilitas pasar sering meningkat menjelang dan sesudah rilis proyeksi besar. Diversifikasi dan tujuan jangka panjang tetap menjadi prinsip dasar pengelolaan keuangan.
segments.tr: - **Retail investors:** Market volatility often increases leading up to and following major projection releases. Diversification and long-term goals remain fundamental principles of financial management.

segments.src: ## Cara Membaca Laporan IMF dengan Bijak
segments.tr: ## How to Read IMF Reports Wisely

segments.src: 1. **Bandingkan dengan proyeksi sebelumnya.** Arah revisi sering lebih informatif daripada angka tunggal.
segments.tr: 1. **Compare with previous projections.** The direction of revisions is often more informative than a single figure.

segments.src: 2. **Perhatikan skenario risiko.** IMF kerap memaparkan skenario risiko ke atas dan ke bawah, bukan hanya satu skenario dasar.
segments.tr: 2. **Pay attention to risk scenarios.** The IMF frequently outlines upside and downside risk scenarios, not just a single baseline scenario.

segments.src: 3. **Lihat konteks Indonesia.** Pertumbuhan dalam negeri sangat ditopang konsumsi domestik, sehingga dampak guncangan global tidak selalu sebanding dengan negara yang lebih bergantung pada ekspor.
segments.tr: 3. **Look at the Indonesian context.** Domestic growth is heavily supported by domestic consumption, so the impact of global shocks is not always comparable to countries that rely more heavily on exports.

segments.src: 4. **Gunakan sumber resmi.** Rujuk dokumen asli IMF dan Bank Dunia, serta rilis Bank Indonesia dan pemerintah, dan hindari mengambil kesimpulan dari kutipan yang terpotong.
segments.tr: 4. **Use official sources.** Refer to original IMF and World Bank documents, as well as Bank Indonesia and government releases, and avoid drawing conclusions from out-of-context quotes.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Pertemuan Tahunan IMF–Bank Dunia Oktober 2026 adalah momentum untuk membaca arah ekonomi dunia.
segments.tr: The October 2026 IMF–World Bank Annual Meetings are a momentum to gauge the direction of the world economy.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, tiga hal yang paling relevan adalah harga minyak, arah suku bunga AS, dan pergerakan arus modal.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, the three most relevant matters are oil prices, the direction of US interest rates, and capital flow movements.

segments.src: Ketiganya saling terkait dan dapat memperkuat atau meredam satu sama lain.
segments.tr: All three are interconnected and can reinforce or mitigate one another.

segments.src: Mengikuti hasil pertemuan ini dengan kepala dingin, merujuk pada sumber resmi, dan memahami bahwa proyeksi dapat berubah akan membantu masyarakat maupun pelaku usaha mengambil keputusan yang lebih terinformasi.
segments.tr: Following the results of these meetings with a clear head, referring to official sources, and understanding that projections can change will help the public and businesses make more informed decisions.

id-20261009-news-3.title: Two Years of the Prabowo–Gibran Administration: A Measurable Framework to Assess MBG, Kopdes Merah Putih, and Food Self-Sufficiency

segments.src: Menjelang 20 Oktober 2026, pemerintahan Prabowo–Gibran memasuki tahun kedua.
segments.tr: Ahead of October 20, 2026, the Prabowo–Gibran administration enters its second year.

segments.src: Setiap peringatan seperti ini biasanya memunculkan dua suara yang saling berhadapan.
segments.tr: Every anniversary like this typically brings up two opposing voices.

segments.src: Pendukung menyebut capaian besar, sedangkan pengkritik menyebut banyak janji belum terwujud.
segments.tr: Supporters cite major achievements, while critics point out that many promises remain unfulfilled.

segments.src: Keduanya sering sama-sama kurang berguna bagi warga yang ingin menilai secara jernih.
segments.tr: Both are often equally unhelpful for citizens who want to make a clear-eyed assessment.

segments.src: Artikel ini tidak menyimpulkan program berhasil atau gagal.
segments.tr: This article does not conclude whether the programs have succeeded or failed.

segments.src: Tujuannya menawarkan **kerangka penilaian**: pertanyaan dan indikator yang bisa dicek siapa pun pada data resmi dan laporan independen.
segments.tr: Its purpose is to offer an **assessment framework**: questions and indicators that anyone can check against official data and independent reports.

segments.src: Angka terbaru sebaiknya diambil dari sumber primer seperti Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS), Badan Gizi Nasional (BGN), Kementerian Pertanian, Bulog, Kementerian Koperasi, dan laporan audit BPK.
segments.tr: The latest figures should preferably be drawn from primary sources such as Statistics Indonesia (BPS), the National Nutrition Agency (BGN), the Ministry of Agriculture, Bulog, the Ministry of Cooperatives, and BPK audit reports.

segments.src: ## Mengapa perlu kerangka, bukan sekadar opini
segments.tr: ## Why a framework is needed, not just opinions

segments.src: Penilaian kebijakan yang baik memisahkan empat hal:
segments.tr: A good policy assessment separates four things:

segments.src: 1. **Input**: anggaran dan sumber daya yang dikeluarkan.
segments.tr: 1. **Input**: the budget and resources expended.

segments.src: 2. **Output**: layanan atau barang yang benar-benar dihasilkan.
segments.tr: 2. **Output**: the services or goods actually produced.

segments.src: 3. **Outcome**: perubahan nyata pada kehidupan warga.
segments.tr: 3. **Outcome**: real changes in citizens' lives.

segments.src: 4. **Tata kelola**: apakah pelaksanaannya transparan, aman, dan akuntabel.
segments.tr: 4. **Governance**: whether implementation is transparent, safe, and accountable.

segments.src: Klaim pemerintah sering berhenti di input dan output, misalnya jumlah dapur atau jumlah koperasi.
segments.tr: Government claims often stop at inputs and outputs, such as the number of kitchens or cooperatives.

segments.src: Kritik sering langsung melompat ke outcome tanpa melihat proses.
segments.tr: Criticism often jumps straight to outcomes without looking at the process.

segments.src: Kerangka ini meminta keduanya diuji bersama.
segments.tr: This framework asks for both to be tested together.

segments.src: ## 1. Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG)
segments.tr: ## 1. Free Nutritious Meal (MBG)

segments.src: MBG bertujuan memperbaiki asupan gizi anak sekolah, ibu hamil, dan kelompok rentan.
segments.tr: MBG aims to improve the nutritional intake of schoolchildren, pregnant women, and vulnerable groups.

segments.src: Program ini berskala sangat besar dan menyerap porsi signifikan anggaran negara.
segments.tr: This program is on a massive scale and absorbs a significant portion of the state budget.

segments.src: **Indikator yang layak dicek:**
segments.tr: **Indicators worth checking:**

segments.src: - **Jangkauan**: jumlah penerima manfaat dibandingkan target, dipecah per provinsi dan per jenjang, termasuk wilayah 3T (terdepan, terluar, tertinggal).
segments.tr: - **Reach**: the number of beneficiaries compared to the target, broken down by province and education level, including 3T regions (frontier, outermost, disadvantaged).

segments.src: - **Kualitas gizi**: apakah menu memenuhi standar kecukupan gizi, dan seberapa sering diaudit oleh ahli gizi.
segments.tr: - **Nutritional quality**: whether menus meet nutritional adequacy standards, and how often they are audited by nutritionists.

segments.src: - **Keamanan pangan**: jumlah dan penanganan kasus keracunan atau gangguan kesehatan, serta kepemilikan sertifikat laik higiene sanitasi di dapur penyedia.
segments.tr: - **Food safety**: the number and handling of poisoning or health disruption cases, as well as the possession of sanitation hygiene certificates in provider kitchens.

segments.src: - **Dampak jangka menengah**: tren prevalensi stunting, anemia, dan status gizi anak dari survei resmi. Perubahan ini butuh waktu, jadi jangan menuntut hasil instan.
segments.tr: - **Medium-term impact**: trends in the prevalence of stunting, anemia, and children's nutritional status from official surveys. These changes take time, so do not demand instant results.

segments.src: - **Efisiensi anggaran**: biaya per porsi, realisasi dibandingkan pagu, dan temuan audit.
segments.tr: - **Budget efficiency**: cost per portion, realization compared to the ceiling, and audit findings.

segments.src: - **Efek ekonomi lokal**: berapa banyak bahan baku berasal dari petani, nelayan, dan UMKM sekitar.
segments.tr: - **Local economic effect**: how many raw materials come from local farmers, fishermen, and MSMEs.

segments.src: **Pertanyaan kritis:** apakah ada mekanisme pengaduan yang mudah diakses orang tua dan sekolah, dan apakah hasil evaluasinya dipublikasikan?
segments.tr: **Critical question:** is there an easily accessible complaint mechanism for parents and schools, and are the evaluation results published?

segments.src: ## 2. Koperasi Desa/Kelurahan Merah Putih
segments.tr: ## 2. Merah Putih Village/Sub-district Cooperatives

segments.src: Gagasannya menghidupkan kembali ekonomi desa lewat koperasi sebagai wadah usaha, distribusi, dan pembiayaan.
segments.tr: The idea is to revive the village economy through cooperatives as hubs for business, distribution, and financing.

segments.src: Koperasi punya sejarah panjang di Indonesia, dengan keberhasilan dan kegagalan yang bisa dijadikan pelajaran.
segments.tr: Cooperatives have a long history in Indonesia, with successes and failures that can serve as lessons.

segments.src: **Indikator yang layak dicek:**
segments.tr: **Indicators worth checking:**

segments.src: - **Pembentukan versus operasi**: berapa koperasi yang sekadar terdaftar secara hukum dan berapa yang sudah menjalankan usaha aktif.
segments.tr: - **Formation versus operation**: how many cooperatives are merely legally registered and how many are running active businesses.

segments.src: - **Kesehatan keuangan**: omzet, sisa hasil usaha (SHU), rasio kredit bermasalah, dan kemampuan membayar kewajiban.
segments.tr: - **Financial health**: turnover, remaining business income (SHU), non-performing loan ratio, and the ability to pay obligations.

segments.src: - **Tata kelola**: apakah rapat anggota berjalan, laporan keuangan dipublikasikan, dan pengurus dipilih secara demokratis.
segments.tr: - **Governance**: whether member meetings take place, financial reports are published, and administrators are democratically elected.

segments.src: - **Manfaat bagi anggota**: apakah harga input pertanian turun, akses modal membaik, dan pendapatan warga naik.
segments.tr: - **Benefits for members**: whether agricultural input prices drop, capital access improves, and citizens' incomes rise.

segments.src: - **Sinergi dan persaingan**: bagaimana hubungan koperasi dengan BUMDes, warung, dan pelaku usaha lokal yang sudah ada.
segments.tr: - **Synergy and competition**: how cooperatives relate to village-owned enterprises (BUMDes), stalls, and existing local businesses.

segments.src: - **Risiko fiskal**: skema pembiayaan dan jaminan yang digunakan, serta potensi beban jika terjadi gagal bayar.
segments.tr: - **Fiscal risk**: the financing and guarantee schemes used, as well as the potential burden in the event of default.

segments.src: **Pertanyaan kritis:** apakah koperasi tumbuh dari kebutuhan dan partisipasi warga, atau hanya dari target administratif?
segments.tr: **Critical question:** do cooperatives grow from the needs and participation of citizens, or merely from administrative targets?

segments.src: ## 3. Swasembada pangan
segments.tr: ## 3. Food self-sufficiency

segments.src: Swasembada biasanya dibicarakan lewat beras, tetapi pangan mencakup jagung, kedelai, gula, daging, dan garam.
segments.tr: Self-sufficiency is usually discussed in terms of rice, but food includes corn, soybeans, sugar, meat, and salt.

segments.src: Target dan definisi perlu jelas: swasembada berarti produksi nasional memenuhi kebutuhan, bukan berarti impor nol dalam segala kondisi.
segments.tr: Targets and definitions need to be clear: self-sufficiency means national production meets demand, not zero imports under all conditions.

segments.src: **Indikator yang layak dicek:**
segments.tr: **Indicators worth checking:**

segments.src: - **Produksi**: angka produksi dan produktivitas per hektare dari BPS, termasuk metode penghitungannya.
segments.tr: - **Production**: production figures and productivity per hectare from BPS, including calculation methods.

segments.src: - **Stok dan cadangan**: cadangan beras pemerintah di Bulog, kualitas simpanan, dan kemampuan menyerap gabah petani.
segments.tr: - **Stocks and reserves**: government rice reserves at Bulog, storage quality, and the capacity to absorb farmers' grain.

segments.src: - **Harga**: tren harga di tingkat petani (nilai tukar petani, harga gabah) dan konsumen (inflasi pangan).
segments.tr: - **Prices**: price trends at the farmer level (farmer terms of trade, grain prices) and consumer level (food inflation).

segments.src: - **Impor**: volume impor komoditas utama dan alasan kebijakannya.
segments.tr: - **Imports**: import volumes of key commodities and the rationale for the policy.

segments.src: - **Input produksi**: ketersediaan dan ketepatan penyaluran pupuk, benih, serta irigasi.
segments.tr: - **Production inputs**: availability and precise distribution of fertilizers, seeds, and irrigation.

segments.src: - **Kesejahteraan petani**: pendapatan bersih petani, bukan hanya volume panen.
segments.tr: - **Farmers' welfare**: farmers' net income, not just harvest volume.

segments.src: - **Ketahanan iklim**: kesiapan menghadapi El Niño, La Niña, dan alih fungsi lahan.
segments.tr: - **Climate resilience**: preparedness for El Niño, La Niña, and land conversion.

segments.src: - **Lahan baru**: kemajuan program cetak sawah atau lumbung pangan, termasuk dampak lingkungan dan sosialnya.
segments.tr: - **New land**: progress on paddy field opening or food estate programs, including environmental and social impacts.

segments.src: **Pertanyaan kritis:** apakah kenaikan produksi diikuti harga yang stabil bagi konsumen dan menguntungkan bagi petani sekaligus?
segments.tr: **Critical question:** is increased production followed by stable prices for consumers while simultaneously being profitable for farmers?

segments.src: ## Indikator lintas program
segments.tr: ## Cross-program indicators

segments.src: Selain per program, ada ukuran umum yang menentukan apakah kebijakan berkelanjutan:
segments.tr: Beyond individual programs, there are general measures that determine whether policies are sustainable:

segments.src: - **Ruang fiskal**: defisit anggaran, rasio utang, dan trade-off dengan belanja pendidikan, kesehatan, serta infrastruktur.
segments.tr: - **Fiscal space**: budget deficit, debt ratio, and trade-offs with spending on education, health, and infrastructure.

segments.src: - **Lapangan kerja dan daya beli**: tingkat pengangguran, pekerjaan informal, dan upah riil.
segments.tr: - **Jobs and purchasing power**: unemployment rate, informal employment, and real wages.

segments.src: - **Transparansi data**: apakah data program terbuka, dapat diunduh, dan diperbarui rutin.
segments.tr: - **Data transparency**: whether program data is open, downloadable, and regularly updated.

segments.src: - **Pengawasan independen**: peran BPK, DPR, ombudsman, akademisi, dan media dalam mengevaluasi.
segments.tr: - **Independent oversight**: the role of BPK, the DPR, the ombudsman, academics, and the media in evaluation.

segments.src: - **Konsistensi kebijakan**: apakah aturan teknis jelas dan tidak berubah-ubah sehingga membingungkan pelaksana di daerah.
segments.tr: - **Policy consistency**: whether technical rules are clear and unchanging so as not to confuse regional implementers.

segments.src: ## Cara membaca klaim dan kritik
segments.tr: ## How to read claims and criticisms

segments.src: Beberapa kebiasaan sederhana membantu pembaca bersikap adil:
segments.tr: A few simple habits help readers remain fair:

segments.src: 1. **Cek sumber dan tanggal data.** Angka tanpa sumber atau tanpa periode belum bisa dibandingkan.
segments.tr: 1. **Check data sources and dates.** Figures without a source or period cannot yet be compared.

segments.src: 2. **Bedakan rata-rata nasional dan kondisi lokal.** Program bisa berjalan baik di satu daerah dan tersendat di daerah lain.
segments.tr: 2. **Differentiate national averages and local conditions.** A program can run well in one region and stall in another.

segments.src: 3. **Perhatikan pembanding.** Naik atau turun dibandingkan apa: tahun lalu, target, atau negara lain?
segments.tr: 3. **Pay attention to comparators.** Up or down compared to what: last year, targets, or other countries?

segments.src: 4. **Pisahkan fakta dari tafsir.** Kasus tunggal penting sebagai peringatan, tetapi belum tentu mewakili seluruh program.
segments.tr: 4. **Separate facts from interpretation.** A single case is important as a warning, but does not necessarily represent the entire program.

segments.src: 5. **Beri waktu yang wajar.** Dampak gizi, koperasi, dan produksi pangan tidak muncul dalam hitungan bulan, namun penundaan juga bukan alasan untuk menghindari evaluasi.
segments.tr: 5. **Give reasonable time.** The impacts on nutrition, cooperatives, and food production do not appear in a matter of months, yet delays are no excuse to avoid evaluation.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Dua tahun adalah titik tengah yang cukup untuk melihat arah, belum cukup untuk memutuskan hasil akhir.
segments.tr: Two years is a midpoint sufficient to see direction, but not yet enough to decide the final outcome.

segments.src: Warga, jurnalis, dan pembuat kebijakan sama-sama diuntungkan bila perdebatan bergeser dari "berhasil atau gagal" menjadi pertanyaan yang lebih bisa dijawab: **apa yang terukur, siapa yang menerima manfaat, berapa biayanya, dan bagaimana kekeliruan dikoreksi**.
segments.tr: Citizens, journalists, and policymakers alike benefit when the debate shifts from "success or failure" to more answerable questions: **what is measurable, who benefits, what does it cost, and how are errors corrected**.

segments.src: Dengan indikator yang jelas dan data yang terbuka, penilaian terhadap pemerintahan, siapa pun yang memimpin, bisa menjadi bahan perbaikan dan bukan sekadar adu klaim.
segments.tr: With clear indicators and open data, the assessment of the government—whosoever leads—can serve as material for improvement rather than merely a contest of claims.

segments.src: *Catatan: artikel ini bersifat informatif dan tidak memuat angka capaian spesifik.
segments.tr: *Note: this article is informative and contains no specific achievement figures.

segments.src: Pembaca disarankan merujuk data resmi terbaru dari lembaga terkait sebelum mengambil kesimpulan.*
segments.tr: Readers are advised to refer to the latest official data from relevant institutions before drawing conclusions.*
